meta_description: Polly Millard is an interior decorator in Bristol specialising in bespoke room transformations. Expert colour advice, wallpaper, and finishing touches. Get your free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Interior Decorator — Bespoke Design & Expert Colour
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning rooms. Polly brings expert colour advice, wallpaper, and finishing touches that genuinely reflect your home.
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refresh or a whole-house makeover, Polly handles every detail with care and creativity.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Bold colour choices that define a room. Polly advises on shades that work with your light, furniture, and mood — then executes a flawless finish.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: From delicate patterns to statement designs. Expert preparation, precise hanging, and a clean, professional result every time.

services.title: Interior Paint Finishing
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and skirting boards painted to a high standard. All surfaces properly prepared and finished with premium paint for lasting colour.

services.title: Colour Consultation
services.desc: Stuck choosing between 50 shades of beige? A one-to-one session exploring your space, light, and lifestyle to find colours that feel right.

services.title: Furniture Refinishing
services.desc: Tired wardrobes, bedframes, or vintage finds given new life with expert painting and finishing techniques.

services.title: Plaster & Wall Prep
services.desc: Cracks, holes, and uneven surfaces fixed before any paint goes on — ensuring your finished look is flawless and long-lasting.

about_pullquote: I decorate homes so people actually want to spend time in them.
about_para_1: Polly has been transforming Bristol interiors for over 12 years. What started as a passion for colour and design has grown into a trusted local reputation. She works directly with each client, listening to your vision and translating it into rooms that feel genuinely like home.
about_para_2: Polly's approach is hands-on and detail-obsessed. She prepares every surface properly, advises honestly on colour and finish, and leaves your home cleaner than when she arrived. Most of her work comes from repeat clients and word-of-mouth recommendation — a testament to her reliability and craft.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Polly

reviews.text: Polly came round for a colour chat about our sitting room and actually listened to what we wanted. She suggested this deep sage green I was terrified of, but it's absolutely perfect. The prep work was meticulous and the paint job is flawless. Couldn't recommend her highly enough.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: We'd had our bedroom redecorated by someone else years ago and it was a nightmare — uneven paint, dodgy wallpaper. Polly came in, sorted the walls properly, and the wallpaper looks like it was done by a professional. Oh wait, it was. Very fair pricing too.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Had Polly do two rooms and she was brilliant. Turned up on time, got on with it, cleaned up after herself every day, and the finish is immaculate. The colour advice was worth every penny — she talked me out of a cream that would've been dull and into a warmer tone that makes the room glow.
reviews.author: Rebecca L.
